# Motorola out-of-tree modules shipped on stock fogona, as
#   <dir in motorola-kernel-modules>  [KBUILD options from the driver's Android.mk]
# Options stand in for the device BoardConfig flags, which Motorola doesn't publish.
# @KSRC@ is replaced with the kernel source dir (some drivers include kernel-internal headers).

drivers/mmi_annotate
drivers/mmi_relay

drivers/power/mmi_charger

drivers/power/cw2217b_fg_mmi
drivers/power/rt9426a_fg_mmi
drivers/power/sm5602_fg_mmi
